Spain Azkena Rock Festival rocks Vitoria Gasteiz with legendary performances, and Turkey Istanbul Caz Festival blends jazz and local musical traditions. Discover how Mediterranean rhythms echo across genres, generations, and cultures.

programme.title: Rick Steves Europe
programme.desc: With its thought-provoking sights, delicious cuisine, and idyllic coastline, it's no wonder Normandy is both a Mecca for history buffs and a popular getaway for Parisians.

programme.title: Med Nations 02 Greece
programme.desc: Greece has a culture that has been shaped by hundreds of years of ideas, traditions, and life on the sea. From the ancient wonders of Athens to the sun-drenched islands of the Aegean, Greece shows this. This trip shows how Greece still inspires the Mediterranean and the world through its food, music, and long history.

programme.title: Med Minds 05 Plato
programme.desc: Plato, the philosopher of Athens, questioned life, truth, and society, leaving ideas that still shape the world.

programme.title: Memoirs September 23
programme.desc: Memoirs September 23

programme.title: Malini Angelica Basque
programme.desc: Malini Angelica visits San Sebastián, Spain’s Basque Country, exploring its unique culture, history, and world-renowned cuisine. She goes on a pintxo crawl, visits La Concha beach, nearby towns like Getaria and Zarautz for local specialties, experiences a traditional txoko, and ends with Semana Grande fireworks.

programme.title: I Regni Romano Barbarici
programme.desc: In the Roman barbarian kingdoms, three needs intersected: barbarian migration, Roman landowner resistance, and Constantinople's effort to control the movement. Germanic peoples, classical culture, and Christianity merged, shaping mediaeval Europe. Paolo Mieli and Professor Alessandro Barbero retrace these historical dynamics in this episode of Past and Present, exploring how the fusion of diverse human groups gave rise to new national identities beyond the Roman Empire.

programme.title: Black Metal Ceremony
programme.desc: Immerse yourself in darkness with this collection of raw, atmospheric black metal. From blistering tremolo riffs to unholy vocals, this playlist evokes ancient rituals and nocturnal desolation. Enter the abyss and join the ceremony.

programme.title: Alternative Metal Paths
programme.desc: Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

programme.title: Heavy Pumping
programme.desc: Ditch the pre-workout and let the riffs do the heavy lifting. This high-octane blast of speed and power is designed to fuel your gains or ignite a living room mosh pit. High BPMs, crushing drums, and zero excuses.

programme.title: Power Metal Journey
programme.desc: Embark on a heroic quest fueled by soaring vocals, blistering guitar solos, and triumphant symphonic melodies. This playlist delivers high-energy anthems, epic fantasy tales, and pure, unstoppable speed metal glory.

programme.title: Metal Detector
programme.desc: Look no further! This is the right place for everything heavy. Your quest has ended so, lean back, turn up that sound system to a solid 11 and enjoy the ride. You have been warned…

programme.title: Death Metal Blasts
programme.desc: Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

programme.title: Right Up Your Alley
programme.desc: As you found your way to our sophisticated TV channel, these music videos should hopefully satisfy your need for cool new Metal- And Rock content. Enjoy and let your friends know! Remember, we’re in this together.

programme.title: Symphonic Metal Epicness
programme.desc: Grand orchestral arrangements meet crushing heavy metal in a majestic display of power. Featuring operatic vocals, sweeping strings, and cinematic soundscapes, this collection delivers pure, dramatic drama on an epic scale.

programme.title: New Rock And Metal Videos For You
programme.desc: Stay ahead of the curve with the freshest drops from the global underground. From world premieres to the latest studio masterpieces, we’ve gathered the newest sonic assaults in one place. If it’s loud and new, it’s here.

programme.title: Gothic Metal Gathering
programme.desc: Step into the shadows with haunting melodies, heavy melancholic riffs, and dramatic symphonic arrangements. A dark, romantic journey through deep sorrow, eerie beauty, and powerful gothic soundscapes.

programme.title: Night Time Metal
programme.desc: The sun is down, the filters are off, and the real chaos begins. Brace yourself for the raw, uncensored side of the scene too heavy for daylight. This is the unfiltered truth of the underground. Adult ears only.

programme.title: BP Ultimate Rally Raid Portugal 2026
programme.desc: The BP Ultimate Rally-Raid joined the W2RC calendar in 2024. The competition on Portuguese and Spanish tracks is always unforgettable for both cars and motorcycles. The event, organized by the Automóvel Club de Portugal, counts as the second round of the calendar. The rally offers a 1,200-kilometer route with wide and varied tracks: from the vast sandy beaches of the Alentejo coast to the busy roads of the Ribatejo region, not forgetting the rocky tracks of the Extremadura province in Spain. Diversity is the key word for the five days of racing! The bivouac is set up in the heart of the town of Grândola, in the province of Setúbal, 100 kilometers south of Lisbon.

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: A woman's seemingly perfect life falls apart when she catches another woman in the arms of her fiance. Things get worse when she is kidnapped but all is not as it seems.

programme.title: Cat And Dog
programme.desc: A pair of young tenants are constantly at odds with their landlord due to unpaid rent. She decides to make their living arrangement very uncomfortable for them.

programme.title: My Baby Mama
programme.desc: Tony's perfect life is derailed when his old girlfriend, Dami, shows up unannounced at his doorstep with a surprise in tow.

programme.title: We Find Us
programme.desc: Jobless Missella faces competition for the heart of his girlfriend, Belinda, from a man that has more money than him.

programme.title: Insight
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. A rich couple's plan to have their first child abroad hits a snag when the man loses his main source of income but refuses to let his wife know. He decides to do several jobs to make up the money but ends up neglecting his wife. Things take a turn when she finds out about the deceit by accident.

programme.title: Daybreak
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. A typical heartbreaker and playboy wakes up to find out that his manhood has disappeared. He consults a prophet and finds out the curse has been put on him by one of the women he has angered and he has 24 hours to seek forgiveness from the one who has cursed him. The problem is, he doesn't know who the culprit is amongst all the women he has angered.

programme.title: Benefit Boys
programme.desc: When a group of school boys suddenly start showing off material things on campus, they raise suspicion about where their sudden wealth has come from.

programme.title: Heart Balm
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. After Abbey suffers a terrible heartbreak, along comes a woman, Nanmi, who would heal him; but with the sudden return of his ex, Folu, Abbey has a difficult choice to make - stay with the woman he has always loved or embrace a fresh start.

programme.title: The Half Sisters Ep18
programme.desc: A situational comedy following the lives of four half sisters who have the same father but different mothers separated along cultural and polygamous lines, and the failed effort of their father to make them bond, separate from their mothers’ petulant quarrels which they have now inherited.

programme.title: The Half Sisters Ep19
programme.desc: A situational comedy following the lives of four half sisters who have the same father but different mothers separated along cultural and polygamous lines, and the failed effort of their father to make them bond, separate from their mothers’ petulant quarrels which they have now inherited.

programme.title: In Bloom - Mare
programme.desc: A collection of 5 short films addressing gender equality issues such as period poverty, child marriage, gender-based violence, HIV and economic empowerment. Third Short: Maré, written and directed by Giuliana Monteiro (Brazil). A mother on the edge of her sanity seeks solace from a tumultuous life situation.

programme.title: You And I S1 - Ep9
programme.desc: You And I revolves around newlyweds, Ayo and Uzooma, as they face the most relatable challenges of marital life. Will love and commitment be enough to overcome the highs, lows, and everything in between?

programme.title: You And I S1 - Ep10

programme.title: Blast From The Past
programme.desc: A long-lost father reappears as a boyfriend. Confused, heartbroken, and desperate for answers, Emily must confront the mystery surrounding her father’s disappearance and his unexpected re-emergence.

programme.title: The Missing Chief Bridesmaid
programme.desc: Detective Lazarus battles life and work as he solves various crime puzzles - from a missing will tearing a family apart, an important package setting him on a wild goose chase, a missing chief bridesmaid days before a wedding and an expensive heirloom. But each case has twists and turns and shows not all is what it seems.

programme.title: Sent From Heaven
programme.desc: A young woman who is desperate for work believes her poor background is what is stopping her from progressing.

programme.title: Hurdles
programme.desc: An arrogant, fastidious and yet successful young lady eventually meets her match. To her dismay, he is unnerved by her attitude, flouts her rules and refuses to bend to her will, causing him to get under her skin.

programme.title: My Burden
programme.desc: The demise of a couple comes after their daughter gets kidnapped by a sex trafficking ring. They both have different ideas on what to do to bring her home successfully.

programme.title: Temptation
programme.desc: After losing his job and plunging his family into financial hardship, David grows suspicious when his wife increasingly finds solace in the church.

programme.title: Peas In A Pod
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. An older couple are seeking divorce after a case of infidelity, that happened many years ago, is revealed.

programme.title: The Will
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Benita's world is turned upside down when she finds out that she is the daughter of a wealthy businessman who recently died. She is invited to the reading of his will but his family make things very hostile for her.

programme.title: The Fourth Party
programme.desc: Sophie Williams, the pregnant daughter of a billionaire chief, is on the verge of being duped and killed in exchange for all her inheritance after trusting the wrong people.

programme.title: Forever Is A Lie
programme.desc: Jason and Ivy are a young couple and partners in love and in crime as they get money from commiting fraudulent activities against unsuspecting victims, however things start to go wrong when jealousy seeps in and one of them takes things too far.

programme.title: AMC Music Lounge S7 - Major AJ
programme.desc: AMC Music Lounge returns for its seventh season bringing you some new interviews, new live performances, fun musical games, and many more from legendary and emerging artistes.

programme.title: Love Over Riches
programme.desc: Pascal's outlook on life changes when he crosses path with a bling young woman. His work and relationship suffers and he is faced with the dilemma to choose between love or the luxury.

programme.title: In Bloom - Alta
programme.desc: A collection of 5 short films addressing gender equality issues such as period poverty, child marriage, gender-based violence, HIV and economic empowerment. Second Short: Alta, written and directed by Priyanka Banerjee (India). programme.title: 2026 AAPI - Fighters of Asian and Pacific Island Heritage
programme.desc: Skill, discipline, legacy. Celebrating fighters of Asian and Pacific Island heritage who bring precision, power, and pride to the PFL and Bellator cages.

programme.title: White People
programme.desc: Alex (Vera Vitali) siepataan kadulla ruokakaupan edessä ja hänet viedään maanalaisiin tiloihin, joissa ihmiset odottavat vangittuina karkotustaan. Viktoria (Pernilla August, “Tähtien Sota: Episodi I – Pimeä uhka”) on operaation pomo, joka hallitsee miehistöään rautaisin ottein.

programme.title: Viking Blood
programme.desc: Ryöstöretkellä ollessaan Tor-viikinki joutuu yllättäen keskelle vuosituhannen sotaa, jota käyvät vanhat ja uudet aasajumalat. Tor päättää, ettei yksikään heistä ansaitse voittoa ja valtaherruutta.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Bitchkram
programme.desc: Kristin laskee päiviä ylioppilaskirjoituksiin, jolloin hän voi jättää pikkukaupungin ja manipuloivan sisarensa unelmiensa New Yorkia varten. Kaikki sujuu täydellisesti, ja paikallislehti julkaisee hänen kolumnejaan.

programme.title: Ariel
programme.desc: Ariel kertoo Taistosta (Turo Pajala, Hamlet liikemaailmassa), pohjoissuomalaisesta kaivosmiehestä. Kun kaivos suljetaan, Taisto kääntää Cadillacin keulan kohti etelää. Helsingissä Taisto asuu Pelastusarmeijan yömajassa, etsii työtä ja rakastuu uutteraan yksinhuoltajaäitiin.

programme.title: Münsterin juttu
programme.desc: Varakas viininmaahantuoja löydetään brutaalisti murhattuna voimakkaan iskun jälkeen päähän. Münster saa tapauksen tutkittavakseen.

programme.title: Hella W
programme.desc: Sankarittaren elämä. Hella Wuolijoen elämä ja työ. Runoilija, vakooja ja miljonääri, josta tuli kansainvälisesti tunnettu liikenainen, poliitikko ja näytelmäkirjailija, joka teki yhteistyötä Euroopan johtavien kirjailijoiden, kuten Bertolt Brechtin ja Maksim Gorkin.

programme.title: Toivon tuolla puolen
programme.desc: TOIVON TUOLLA PUOLEN kertoo hiililaivalla Helsinkiin rantautuvasta Khaledista (Sherwan Haji), Syyrian sodan pakolaisesta, joka etsii matkalla kadonnutta sisartaan.

programme.title: Boheemielämää
programme.desc: Boheemielämää kertoo kolmen taiteilijan tarinan. Kirjailija Marcel Marxin, taidemaalari Rodolfon ja säveltäjä Shaunardin, rakkauksien, töiden ja ainaisen rahapulan värittämään taiteilijaelämään pureutuva elokuva perustuu Henri Murgerin kuuluisaan samannimiseen romaaniin vuodelta 1851.

programme.title: Horizon Line
programme.desc: Ex-pariskunta tapaa vuosien jälkeen osallistuessaan hyvän ystävänsä häihin. Heidän lentäessään trooppiselle saarelle valtameren yli pienellä, yksimoottorisella lentokoneella, pilotti saa kohtalokkaan sydänkohtauksen.

programme.title: Juha
programme.desc: Juha (Sakari Kuosmanen, Kauas pilvet karkaavat) ja Marja (Kati Outinen, Sauna) elävät yhdessä onnellisina ja viattomina kuin lapset kunnes käärme luikertelee paratiisiin Shemeikan (André Wilms, Boheemielämää) hahmossa. Juha perustuu Juhani Ahon kuuluisaan romaaniin.

programme.title: Gourmet Club
programme.desc: Paavo Ylönen kuuluu yläluokkaiseen Gourmet Clubiin, johon jokainen jäsen tuo vuorollaan eksoottisen raaka-aineen. Se, joka tunnistaa mikä kätkeytyy gourmet-annokseen, voittaa suuren summan rahaa.

programme.title: Rikos ja rangaistus
programme.desc: Rikos ja rangaistus on moderni tulkinta Dostojevskin kuuluisasta romaanista. Murhaajan (Markku Toikka) ja poliisin (Esko Nikkari, Mies vailla menneisyyttä) huimaava psykologinen kaksintaistelu tapahtuu öisen Helsingin sivukujilla ja lain tuolla puolen.

programme.title: Ykköset Ja Nollat - Osa 2
programme.desc: Kriitikoiden ylistämä brutaali gangsteridraama Johan Renckiltä! FBI ja Interpol saavat vihiä suuresta luottokorttisotkusta, ja narkkari Sebbe napataan kiinni epäiltynä. Poliisin aloittaessa kuulustelun he saavat kuulla uskomattoman tarinan Göteborgin alamaailmasta.

programme.title: White People
programme.desc: Alex (Vera Vitali) siepataan kadulla ruokakaupan edessä ja hänet viedään maanalaisiin tiloihin, joissa ihmiset odottavat vangittuina karkotustaan. Viktoria (Pernilla August, “Tähtien Sota: Episodi I – Pimeä uhka”) on operaation pomo, joka hallitsee miehistöään rautaisin ottein.

programme.title: In the Name of God
programme.desc: Elokuva Jumalanpalvelus kertoo Theodorista, joka on pappi pienessä kylässä, josta tulee puheenaihe siitä syystä, että hänen vaimonsa parani kuin ihmeen kautta tappavasta taudista Theodorin rukousten ansiosta.

programme.title: Lindell - Orkesterimonttu - Osa 1
programme.desc: Elämänsä parhaan esityksen jälkeen oopperassa ensiviulisti Siv Ellen Blad murhataan julmasti. Rikoskomisario Cato Isaksen saa nopeasti selville, että hän oli joutunut postiryöstön kohteeksi. Piileekö siinä yhteys?

programme.title: Lindell - Orkesterimonttu - Osa 2
programme.desc: Elämänsä parhaan esityksen jälkeen oopperassa ensiviulisti Siv Ellen Blad murhataan julmasti. Rikoskomisario Cato Isaksen saa nopeasti selville, että hän oli joutunut postiryöstön kohteeksi. Piileekö siinä yhteys?

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: I Hired a Contract Killer
programme.desc: Henri Boulanger (Jean-Pierre Léaud) seisoo vähäpätöisen virkansa menetettyään keskellä Lontoon miljoonakaupunkia ja huomaa, ettei hänellä ole ainoatakaan ystävää eikä sukulaista.

programme.title: Rikos ja rangaistus
programme.desc: Rikos ja rangaistus on moderni tulkinta Dostojevskin kuuluisasta romaanista. Murhaajan (Markku Toikka) ja poliisin (Esko Nikkari, Mies vailla menneisyyttä) huimaava psykologinen kaksintaistelu tapahtuu öisen Helsingin sivukujilla ja lain tuolla puolen.

programme.title: The Quiet Roar
programme.desc: Marianne (Evabritt Strandberg) on 68-vuotias nainen, jolla on parantumaton sairaus. Ahdistuneena hän hakeutuu terapiaan klinikalle, jossa häntä hoidetaan psilosybiinilla (LSD:llä) ja hoitaja Eva (Hanna Schygulla) johdattaa hänet meditaatioon.

programme.title: Boheemielämää
programme.desc: Boheemielämää kertoo kolmen taiteilijan tarinan. Kirjailija Marcel Marxin, taidemaalari Rodolfon ja säveltäjä Shaunardin, rakkauksien, töiden ja ainaisen rahapulan värittämään taiteilijaelämään pureutuva elokuva perustuu Henri Murgerin kuuluisaan samannimiseen romaaniin vuodelta 1851.

programme.title: Beyond Dreams
programme.desc: Mirja (Evin Ahmad) etsii paikkaansa maailmassa vankilasta päästyään. Saatuaan töitä hotellisiivoojana hän alkaa elää kaksoiselämää. Hänen sairas äitinsä ja vanhat ystävänsä, jotka ovat olleet hänen oikea perheensä, repivät häntä kahtaalle.

programme.title: JP ja Murtovaras
programme.desc: Sallikkalan kuntaa piinaa sarja murtovarkauksia, ja luvattomalle yöseikkailulle lähtenyt lapsikolmikko luulee nähneensä varkaan itse teossa! Nyt on perustettava salapoliisitoimisto ja ratkaistava juttu!

programme.title: Valehtelija
programme.desc: Valehtelija on kuvaus nuoresta huulenheittäjästä, joka ei koskaan puhu totta. Aki Kaurismäen esittämä nuori mies kuljeskelee pitkin Helsingin katuja ja koittaa lainata rahaa tutuilta ja tuntemattomilta, milloin milläkin verukkeella.

programme.title: Hella W
programme.desc: Sankarittaren elämä. Hella Wuolijoen elämä ja työ. Runoilija, vakooja ja miljonääri, josta tuli kansainvälisesti tunnettu liikenainen, poliitikko ja näytelmäkirjailija, joka teki yhteistyötä Euroopan johtavien kirjailijoiden, kuten Bertolt Brechtin ja Maksim Gorkin.

programme.title: Hamlet liikemaailmassa
programme.desc: Maailmankirjallisuuden tunnetuin sukudraama on siiretty nykysuomen liike-elämän vallan linnakkeisiin, keskelle Helsingin rock´n rollin tahdissa sykkivää betoniviidakkoa.

programme.title: Zombie ja kummitusjuna
programme.desc: Zombie on oman tiensä kulkija, joka ei pysty noudattamaan suomalaisen yhteiskunnan hänelle asettamia normeja. Zombie päättää jättää kaiken ja suunnata ulkomaille - paikkaan jossa kukaan ei odota häneltä mitään. Zombie ja kummitusjuna kuuluu monien mielestä Mika Kaurismäen elokuvien parhaimmistoon.

programme.title: Le Havre
programme.desc: Parhaan elokuvan Jussi-palkinnon voittaja ja myös kansainvälisesti palkittu elokuva, voitti myös 2011 Cannesin elokuvajuhlilla, elokuvakriitikkojen järjestön Fiprescin palkinnon, parhaan koiranäyttelijän sekä ekumeenisen tuomariston palkinnot.

programme.title: Akvaariorakkaus
programme.desc: Anna-Leena Härkösen menestysromaaniin perustuva elokuva itseään etsivästä Saarasta ja Jonista (Nicke Lignell), joka yrittää tehdä kaikkensa auttaakseen Saaraa, mutta tehtävä osoittautuu mahdottomaksi.

programme.title: Bieffekterna
programme.desc: Lääketieteen opiskelijat ja ohjelmoijat Julia ja Rebecca kuuluvat Lundin yliopiston eliittiryhmään, joka tutkii kiistanalaista tieteellistä menetelmää biohakkerointia, geenitekniikan uutta toivoa, joka saattaa merkitä tappavien sairauksien loppua.

programme.title: Viking Blood
programme.desc: Ryöstöretkellä ollessaan Tor-viikinki joutuu yllättäen keskelle vuosituhannen sotaa, jota käyvät vanhat ja uudet aasajumalat. Tor päättää, ettei yksikään heistä ansaitse voittoa ja valtaherruutta.

programme.title: A Change Of Face
programme.desc: As Darrin naps in the living room, Endora points out some of the unfortunate details of his face. Samantha at first protests when her mother, using witchcraft, changes Darrin's looks but then adds some touches of her own. Awakening, Darrin demands an explanation. Samantha can't explain why she and Endora were changing his features, and Darrin begins to worry. As the obsession grows, Samantha decides to build up her husband's ego. Changing her own personality, Samantha becomes a French sculptress, Michelle. She tells Darrin his face exudes the masculine appeal she has always tried to find in a model. Darrin turns down Michelle's request that he pose for her, suspecting that she is Samantha. A substitute secretary, Barbara Lucas, appears at the office and Darrin, thinking it is another of Samantha's tricks, makes a play for her, just as Samantha walks in. Her jealous reaction convinces Darrin that Samantha really loves him. Darrin explains be thought she was posing as Barbara, but leaves Samantha with an uncertain feeling.

programme.title: Remember The Main
programme.desc: In every way, Samantha and Darrin Stephens are a perfectly normal, all-American couple, except for one small detail...Samantha's a witch!

programme.title: Eat At Mario's
programme.desc: Samantha and Endora discover the culinary delights of Mario's restaurant. Mario tells them he is going broke because he refuses to sell pizza. Samantha learns that Darrin's agency has a new client, Linton Baldwin, the owner of a large chain of pizza parlors. When Samantha uses witchcraft to get a huge newspaper ad for Mario, and Endora inserts a plug for him on Baldwin's TV program, Baldwin tells Larry Tate he is cancelling his account and signing with the agency handling Mario's restaurant. Realizing Darrin's career is in jeopardy, Samantha persuades Endora to help save the Baldwin account for Darrin. They lay out a spectacular advertising campaign for Baldwin and give the credit to Darrin's agency. Not only does Baldwin ask Darrin's agency to keep his account, but Mario's restaurant becomes a great success.

programme.title: Cousin Edgar
programme.desc: Almost as determined as Endora to break up Samantha's marriage to a mere mortal, Samantha's cousin Edgar, an elf, begins playing pranks on Darrin. Darrin's agency has been trying to hold onto the Shelley Shoe account. Edgar, invisible to all, plagues Darrin in his office. Darrin is sure Endora is working on him again, and has difficulty persuading Larry Tate to let him present the new campaign to Mr. Shelley. At the sales meeting, Fred Schulwiler, as unscrupulous competitor, almost gets the account when he makes it appear that Darrin is trying to make Mr. Shelley look ridiculous. When Samantha convinces Edgar that she is very happy with Darrin, he switches his attentions to Schulwiler. Before Edgar is through, Schulwiler has lost all chance of landing the Shelley account. Darrin, coming up with an advertising campaign featuring an elf not unlike Edgar, ties up the account for his firm.

programme.title: Alias Darrin Stephens
programme.desc: Samantha's Aunt Clara arrives on the Stephens' first anniversary with presents for Samantha and Darrin. Casting a spell to adjust a checkered cap she has given Darrin, Aunt Clara uses the wrong words and turns Darrin into a chimpanzee. Unable to remember how to remove the spell, Aunt Clara goes home to look for the formula. When Samantha leaves the house, Endora stays with Darrin. Darrin leaps out of a window and runs into Gladys Kravitz. She takes the chimp back to her house. Soon after, Aunt Clara comes with her book of magic, Samantha returns. Samantha tells Aunt Clara she must find Darrin since her doctor has told her she is going to have a baby. Meanwhile, Gladys and Abner have turned Darrin over to the zoo, where he is caged with three other chimps. Samantha goes to the zoo. Then Aunt Clam arrives and turns Darrin back to his former self. Samantha is finally able to tell him he is to be a father. Later, Gladys begins telling the Stephens about the chimpanzee. Suddenly realizing that Darrin is wearing the same outfit as the chimp, Gladys streaks back to her own house.

programme.title: A Very Special Delivery
programme.desc: Learning that he is about to become a father, Darrin waits on Samantha hand and foot. Then Larry Tate convinces him that all women would make a career out of having a baby if you allowed them to. He gives Darrin a book on the subject which states that the more active the mother, the happier she will be, and the healthier the child. Darrin returns home completely convinced. Endora is infuriated when she hears Darrin ordering Samantha to do chores around the house. The following day, Darrin wakes up with a backache. At an office lunch, he fights for extra pickles. When Samantha learns of this, she faces up to her mother. Endora admits she has cast a spell over Darrin, but will do nothing to change the situation for the present. Darrin, dis-cussing his plight at a bar, becomes obsessed with the idea that he is going to have a baby himself. Finally, Endora removes the spell and Darrin becomes completely attentive to Samantha once more. She agrees with Darrin's assertion that he is one man in a million who knows just how she feels.

programme.title: We'Re In For A Bad Spell
programme.desc: When strange things begin happening to Adam Newlarkin, a friend of Darrin's, Aunt Clara tells Samantha he has inherited the spell placed by a witch on his ancestor who was a judge in Salem two hundred years before. Aunt Clara adds that unless Adam follows the antidote for the spell strictly, he will be branded a thief. The Stephens learn that Adam has been hired by a local bank. Samantha and Darrin manage to get Adam to kiss a dog, the first step. With Aunt Clara's help, Darrin dunks Adam in a pool three times. They have trouble persuading him to ride through town shouting praise of witches, which is the final step. However, finding his briefcase stuffed with money , Adam, a true native of Salem, believes he is under a spell. He mounts a horse and starts riding. Bank manager Abercrombie and a detective, having discovered the loss of seventy five thousand dollars, come to the Stephens' home. Aunt Clara makes the money disappear from the briefcase. Abercrombie apologizes to Adam after learning that a bank employee has been taken into custody with the stolen cash.

programme.title: My Grandson, The Warlock
programme.desc: Phoning from London, the Tates inform the Stephens that their governess has been taken ill. They ask Darrin and Samantha to care for the child until they return. Gladys Kravitz sees them leaving the house and returning with a baby. Assuming the Stephens' baby has arrived, Gladys congratulates Maurice, Samantha's father, on the birth of his grandson. Maurice is shocked to find the baby is not being taught witchcraft. He flies away with the child to the Warlock's Club in London. Meanwhile, the Tates arrive at the local airport. Darrin tries to stall while Samantha finds their baby. In London, after many tests, the Warlocks tell Maurice the baby hasn't got it. Nanny Witch adds that the baby is a mortal like the father. At the Stephens home, Samantha and Darrin are about to tell the Tates their baby is missing, when Maurice arrives with the child. Maurice's pride is restored when Samantha tells him her baby is not due for several months. Arriving with a present, Gladys is told to wait until Samantha's baby is born. Before vanishing through a wall, Maurice hands Gladys a martini. Watching Gladys down it, Samantha hopes she will not remember what she has seen and heard.

programme.title: The Joker Is A Card
programme.desc: Samantha arranges a meeting between Darrin and her mother which she hopes will settle their differences. A series of minor accidents sets Darrin and Endora accusing each other of being practical pokers. Realizing someone else is responsible, Samantha uncovers a serving dish and reveals her Uncle Arthur, who dotes on practical jokes. Infuriated by Darrin's uproarious appreciation of Uncle Arthur, Endora plants a Beatles hairdo on Darrin. Darrin refuses Uncle Arthur's offer to teach him some magic so he can stand up to Endora, until he is knocked out by an accident in the office. Certain Endora is at work, Darrin accepts Uncle Arthur's offer. Following Uncle Arthur's weird instructions, Darrin tries to make Endora disappear. When she does not, Darrin realizes he has been the victim of another of Uncle Arthur's pranks. Samantha enlists Endora and Darrin in a plan to cure Uncle Arthur. Arthur is incredulous when Darrin says he can turn Endora into a parrot. When Endora becomes a parrot (through her own witchcraft), Arthur pleads with Darrin to remove the spell. Endora then returns to normal and demands that Arthur stop his practical jokes, which Uncle Arthur accepts. Before leaving, Uncle Arthur gives Endora a pair of opera glasses. When she lowers them she has two black eyes.

programme.title: And Then I Wrote
programme.desc: Dr. Passmore, psychiatrist at a rest home, tells Samantha his patients would like to do something to mark the Centennial of the End of the War Between the States. Samantha tells him Darrin will publicize the affair. Annoyed, Darrin tells Passmore Samantha will write a script for the pageant. Darrin criticizes Samantha's wooden characters. Taking Endora's advice, Samantha uses magic to bring her characters to life, so she can describe them. Soon Confederate Captain Corcoran, Violet, a beautiful Yankee, and an Indian, added for a neutral touch, are wandering around the Stephens' home. Seeing them, Gladys Kravitz flips. When Darrin arrives, the characters refuse to leave. How-ever, they vanish when Darrin kisses Samantha. Gladys tells her story to Passmore. He prescribes for her, but seeing the characters himself, decides he needs a vacation. When Samantha's writing comes to a halt, Corcoran, Violet and the Indian finish the script themselves and leave. After the pageant, Samantha is asked to create a vaudeville revue for the rest home. Two song and dance men appear. Gladys sees them and runs screaming into the night. programme.desc: Darrin is struggling to create an advertising campaign for a toy ship model manufactured by Mr. Herding. Samantha repeats a disparaging remark Darrin made about Endora. Piqued, Endora turns Darrin into a boy at his office. Mr. Harding sees Darrin and compli-ments Larry on hiring a child to devise a campaign for a toy. Samantha uses magic to return Darrin to normal size but is called on time after time to change him from man to boy when Harding insists on having a point meeting with Darrin and the boy. Finally, as a child, Darrin meets two boys who tell him the ship model is no good because it can't do anything. As Darrin, the man, persuades Harding and Larry to make the changes suggested by the two boys, Samantha gratefully produces a kite for each. When Darrin tells her he'd like to join them, Saman-tha replies he'll have his own son to play with soon.

programme.title: Aunt Clara's Old Flame
programme.desc: Aunt Clara tells Samantha and Endora she is hiding from warlock Hedley Partridge, because she fears her old beau will discover her magic no longer works. Seeing in Hedley a husband for Aunt Clara, who has become a problem, Endora invites him to the Stephens home. Samantha decides to make sure Aunt Clara's tricks work. Unaware of this, Aunt Clara is sure her gift is returned when she matches all of Hedley's tricks. When Samantha goes out of the room, Aunt Clara tries to follow Hedley's ro-mantic suggestion that they turn themselves into nightingales, but Hedley becomes an animal, while Aunt Clara's lower half disappears. Gladys Kravitz, who has become hysterical watching the strange happenings, drags Abner over to the Stephens house. When Samantha returns Aunt Clara and Hedley to normal, Aunt Clara is crushed to learn that Samantha helped her all along. Gladys skeptically accepts Abner's explanation that Hedley's magic was performed with the aid of wires. Aunt Clara and Hedley each admit that none of their tricks work as well as they used to. Promising to return, Hedley leaves. Aunt Clara tells Samantha his parting gift a rhinestone doorknob, is more precious than an engagement ring.

programme.title: A Strange Little Visitor
programme.desc: Walter and Margaret Brocken ask Samantha to keep their son Merle, a ten year old warlock, while they attend a witches convention. When Merle agrees not to do any magic before Darrin, Samantha invites him to stay. Meanwhile, Larry Tate asks Darrin to keep an expensive necklace, a birthday present for. his wife, at the Stephens home. Darrin goes to Merle's room, where the young warlock has turned a hairbrush into a model fire engine, which flashes with electric shocks when Darrin touches it. Darrin shouts with pain until Merle turns off the current. Samantha is now forced to disclose that Merle is a warlock. Merle again promises Samantha to refrain from magic in the house. That night a burglar who had seen Larry giving Darrin the necklace breaks in and overpowers Darrin. Darrin calls on Merle for a magical assist, but Merle stands by his promise. When the burglar finds the necklace, Darrin cons him into taking the fire engine too. As he reaches for it, Merle turns on his magic. Later, Gladys is more bewildered than ever as she hears the burglar explaining to the police how he was captured by a toy fire engine.

programme.title: Fastest Gun On Madison Avenue
programme.desc: Joe Kovack makes a play for Samantha in a restaurant. Darrin rushes to her defense. Realizing Darrin faces certain slaughter, Samantha twitches her nose and Joe falls to the floor, Since Joe is Number One contender for the heavyweight title, newspapers hail Darrin as a coming champ. Darrin pleads with Samantha to let him fight, his own battles. Then, Joe and his Manager, trying to regain a crack at a lucrative championship bout, approach Darrin with a plan for a make-believe bout in which Joe pretends to knock Darrin out. Again, Darrin with the uncalled-on help of Samantha K.O.'s Joe. Finally, Darrin runs into Tommy Carter, the champ-himself. An unplanned for scuffle takes place. Tommy trips and knocks himself out. Later, Larry Tate tells Darrin he has solved the problem by hiring Tommy. Tommy's first assignment is to fight a four-round bout for charity. Darrin quakes at learning that Tommy is to choose his opponent. However, he sadly concludes that with Samantha insisting on being his second, he can't help winning again.

programme.title: Double Tate
programme.desc: For his birthday, Endora decides to make three of Darrin's wishes come true. Unaware of the gift, Darrin gets immediate elevator service in his office building, and they see a bikini-clad beauty. An important client, Randolph Turgeon, insists on seeing Larry Tate, who is in Chicago. Wishing he were Larry for just one day, Darrin immediately turns into his boss. Turgeon introduces Darrin-Larry to his niece, Joyce, who wants a job with the agency. Louise Tate, who thinks her husband is with another woman, slaps her face, and makes him come home. Darrin phones Samantha for help. She arrives immediately, but is un-able to remove the spell. Just as Samantha is telling Darrin--Larry the spell will be over in fifteen minutes, Larry himself walks in. Hoping to keep the confusion from getting worse, Samantha puts Louise to sleep, and tells Larry his wife has been sleep-walking. Safe at home, Samantha tells Darrin Louise will feel she dreamed the whole episode. She asks Darrin what his first two wishes were. He mentions the elevator but decides to forget the girl in the bikini.

programme.title: Samantha, The Dressmaker
programme.desc: Samantha tries unsuccessfully to make her own dress for an affair at the home of an agency client, J.T. Glendon. Whisking Samantha to Paris, Endora takes her to the showroom of Aubert, a couturier who has failed in his attempts to break into the American market. Back home, Samantha uses magic to duplicate an Aubert original. Doris, J.T,'s wife admires the dress. Suddenly. Samantha finds herself committed to making dresses for Doris, J.T.'s sister, Ethel, and Gladys Kravitz. Darrin reveals J.T.'s party is a preview of original creations by his new client, Aubert. Samantha is stunning but the other three women look awful in their creations. Aubert faints when he sees the women wearing his originals. Later Darrin tells Samantha that Aubert, certain he has been doublecrossed, is suing the agency. Samantha convinces Aubert that he has failed in the American market because he hasn't created dresses for women like Doris and Gladys. With Aubert designing, Samantha finishes dresses for another show in which even Gladys is a standout.

programme.title: The Leprechaun
programme.desc: Darrin reacts violently when he finds Brian O'Brian, a sprightly leprechaun, a guest in his home. Samantha tells him that Brian is not her relative but the leprechaun of Darrin's family. Brian reveals he has come to recover his pot of gold which was hidden in a fireplace brought to America by James Dennis Robinson. Darrin finds that Robinson owns a company whose account would be a great asset to Darrin's agency. Brian breaks into Robinson's house to retrieve the gold and is arrested. Darrin allows Samantha to use her magic to get Brian out of jail. Brian pleads with Samantha to help him recover his pot of gold which will restore his lost powers. Pledging Brian never to tell Darrin, Samantha returns with him to the Robinson's house. Robinson finds them in his study and reveals he has already removed the pot from the fireplace. Samantha is sur-prised when Robinson tells her he believes the leprechaun's story because his grandfather was a Mahoney, and returns Brian's pot of gold. Brian agrees to allow Robinson to use his picture as a trade mark if Robinson turns his advertising over to Darrin.

programme.title: Nobody's Perfect
programme.desc: Dr. Koblin reports that Tabitha is a normal baby. But, Samantha sees a toy pony floating in the air to Tabitha when she wiggles her fingers, and realizes the baby has inherited her witchcraft.

programme.title: The Moment Of Truth
programme.desc: Samantha still hasn't found the courage to tell Darrin Tabitha is a witch.

programme.title: Witches And Warlocks Are My Favorite Things
programme.desc: Endora tells Samantha that her aunts are coming to the Stephens' home to test Tabitha's powers of witchcraft.

programme.title: Accidental Twins
programme.desc: Aunt Clara baby-sits with Tabitha Stephens and Timothy Tate when their parents go to the theatre.

programme.title: A Most Unusual Wood Nymph
programme.desc: Gerry O'Toole, a beautiful Irish girl who is a friend of Darrin's aunt arrives for a visit and announces she plans to stay with the Stephens until she gets a job.

programme.title: Endora Moves In For A Spell
programme.desc: Uncle Arthur pops out of a painting in the Stephens home. Samantha tells him she is trying to stop Endora from encouraging Tabitha to use her witchcraft.

programme.title: Twitch Or Treat
programme.desc: Darrin is incensed when Endora makes a house appear on a vacant lot near the Stephens home for a Halloween party.

programme.title: Dangerous Diaper Dan
programme.desc: Diaper Dan, secretly working for the A.J. Kimberly Adver-tising Agency, gives Samantha a baby rattle. As the rattle is bugged, Dan is able to tape all the conversation at the Stephens home.

programme.title: Surrounded
programme.desc: Entinen sotilas Mo Washington matkaa länteen etsimään kultakaivosta. Väijytys pakottaa hänet vangitsemaan lainsuojattoman, johtaen taisteluun karussa erämaassa. Ohjaaja: Anthony Mandler. Pääosissa Letitia Wright, Jamie Bell ja Michael K. Williams.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3
programme.desc: Eletään 1600-luvun alkua feodaaliajan Japanissa, ja ratsain kulkeva mies jää vangiksi taistelussaan samurairyhmää vastaan. Vajaat 400 vuotta myöhemmin toimittaja April O’Neil hankkii kirpputorilta lahjoja kilpikonnaystävilleen.

programme.title: Legal Action
programme.desc: Lahjakas asianajaja Casey McKay matkustaa ex-vaimonsa kotikaupunkiin puolustamaan tämän veljeä, jota syytetään piirisyyttäjän murhasta. Siellä McKay saa selville salaliiton, joka johtaa hänet avoimeen konfliktiin kaupungin korruptoituneimman rakennuttajan Gatesin kanssa.

programme.title: Superkyttä
programme.desc: Dave Speed on Miamin poliisivoimien rämäpää, jolta rikollisuuden kitkeminen hoituu luonnostaan. Erästä tehtävää hoitaessaan, Dave altistuu pahemman kerran ydinaseen säteilylle, eikä mikään ole enää kuin ennen.

programme.title: Ullakkojengi (Aliens in the Attic)
programme.desc: Vihdoinkin kesäloma – mutta Pearsonin lapset ovat jumissa tylsällä mökillä. Kunnes ärhäkät pienet avaruusoliot laskeutuvat katolle suunnitellen mökin JA maailman valloitusta, ja nuorten on yhdistettävä voimansa ja videopelitaitonsa pelastaakseen maailman!

programme.title: The Happytime Murders
programme.desc: Melissa McCarthyn tähdittämä räävittömän hillitön komedia Elokuva sijoittuu Los Angelesin laitamille, jossa nuket ja ihmiset elävät rinta rinnan.

programme.title: TMNT
programme.desc: Splinter; rotta sensei; aistii, että hänen neljä teini-ikäistä kilpikonnaopettajaansa ovat eronneet ja heidän on luotava side voittaakseen muinaisen hirviön.

programme.title: Alvin Ja Pikkuoravat 3
programme.desc: Lomailevat pikkuoravat ja tyttötrio muuttavat luksusristeilijän omaksi leikkikentäkseen kunnes he haaksirikkoutuvat syrjäiselle saarelle.

programme.title: Pete Smalls Is Dead
programme.desc: Hollywoodin taakseen jättänyt käsikirjoittaja joutuu palaamaan unelmien kaupunkiin ohjaajaystävänsä kuoltua.

programme.title: Hamekyttä 2
programme.desc: Hamekytän villissä jatko-osassa Martin Lawrence ja Nia Long palaavatviihdyttämään koko perhettä. Kansakunnan turvallisuus on uhattuna ja FBI-agenttiMalcolm Turner in on jälleen kerran...

programme.title: Taxi 4
programme.desc: Pahanilmanlintu Émilienillä Marseillen rikospoliisista on huostassaan yksi Euroopan etsityimmistä miehistä.

programme.title: Neuvottelija
programme.desc: Poliisille työskentelevä taitava neuvottelija, jota syytetään korruptiosta ja murhasta, yrittää epätoivoisesti todistaa syyttömyytensä ottamalla panttivankeja hallituksen toimistotiloissa saadakseen tarpeeksi aikaa totuuden selvittämiseen.

programme.title: Senkka nenästä pojat!
programme.desc: Järjestäytyneen rikollisuuden vedonlyöjät, korttihait ja huijarit piinaavat toimillaan Miamia, ja poliisin johto on päättänyt ottaa kovat keinot käyttöön ja puhdistaa kaupungin.

programme.title: Bulletproof Monk
programme.desc: Vuosikausien ajan nimetön munkki on puolustanut ja suojellut muinaista kääröä – Äärettömän Voiman Kääröä – joka sisältää avaimen mittaamattomaan voimaan. Nyt munkin täytyy löytää suojatti; seuraava suojelija salaisuudelle.

programme.title: Cypher
programme.desc: Yritysvakoilun hämärässä valtakunnassa kyllästynyt jokamies kompastuu petoksen verkkoon ja hänestä tulee tietämätön vakooja. Kun hän navigoi petoksessa ja petoksessa, hän tekee yhteistyötä viettelevän arvoituksen kanssa paljastaakseen järkyttäviä totuuksia ja saadakseen takaisin identiteettinsä.

programme.title: Pete Smalls Is Dead
programme.desc: Hollywoodin taakseen jättänyt käsikirjoittaja joutuu palaamaan unelmien kaupunkiin ohjaajaystävänsä kuoltua.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Keskiajan historia kirjoitetaan uudelleen, kun Jamal Walker putoaa Medieval World -teemapuiston vallihautaan ja huomaa siirtyneensä ajassa taaksepäin.

programme.title: Beyond the Edge
programme.desc: Lahjakas uhkapeluri Michael saa viikon aikaa maksaa rikolliselle yhtiölle, muuten hänet tapetaan. Hän kerää joukon yliluonnollisia kykyjä omaavia voittaakseen suuren summan rahaa kasinolla, mutta vastustaja onkin odotettua vahvempi. Edessä on täysin uusi maailma ystävien voimien avulla.

programme.title: Impact Earth
programme.desc: Liity tähtitieteen professorin matkaan, kun hän kilpailee aikaa vastaan ​​pelastaakseen perheensä maata kohti suuntautuvalta katastrofaaliselta asteroidilta yrittäen samalla varoittaa maailmaa. Selviytyykö ihmiskunta?

programme.title: Survivor
programme.desc: Survivor on sähäkkä vakoiluelokuva Kate Abbottista, joka saa siirron Yhdysvaltain suurlähetystöön Lontooseen. Hänen tehtävänään on varmistaa, ettei terroristeille myönnetä viisumeja Yhdysvaltoihin. Erikoislaatuinen tehtävä tekee Abbottista silmätikun ja maalitaulun.

programme.title: Max Steel
programme.desc: Suosittuun Mattel-lelusarjaan ja tv-sarjaan perustuen Max Steel on teini-ikäinen uuden sukupolven supersankari, ja elokuvassa toiminta, komedia ja modernit erikoistehosteet muodostavat eeppisen koko perheen seikkailun.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Banaani Joen elämä on yhtä auringonpaistetta. Lokoisaa iloista oloa, ilman stressiä eteläisellä paratiisisaarella, kunnes... Joen asuinkylä on jäämässä modernin business-kulttuurin jalkoihin. Pian paikkaa pyörittävät byrokraatit ja jengit, pykälineen ja paheineen.

programme.title: Varkaita ja veijareita
programme.desc: Bud Spencer esittää kovanyrkkistä poliisia, ylikonstaapeli Parkeria, joka saa tehtäväkseen ottaa kiinni lipevän gigolon, Tony Roman. Tony todistaa Mafian tappoiskun.

programme.title: TMNT
programme.desc: Splinter; rotta sensei; aistii, että hänen neljä teini-ikäistä kilpikonnaopettajaansa ovat eronneet ja heidän on luotava side voittaakseen muinaisen hirviön.

programme.title: Machete Kills
programme.desc: Danny Trejo tekee tajunnanräjäyttävän paluun entisen FBI-agentti Macheten saappaisiin Robert Rodriguezin ohjaamassa, edeltäjäänsäkin roisimmassa jatko-osassa. Kuoleman porteilta palannut tappokone Machete on jälleen pelikentällä - tällä kertaa lain oikealla puolella.

programme.title: The Perfect Weapon
programme.desc: Lähitulevaisuus. Condor (Johnny Messner) toimii tiukkaa kuria pitävän Valtion ja sitä diktaattorin ottein ohjailevan Johtajan (Steven Seagal) mitään kyselemättömänä palkkamurhaajana.

programme.title: Neuvottelija
programme.desc: Poliisille työskentelevä taitava neuvottelija, jota syytetään korruptiosta ja murhasta, yrittää epätoivoisesti todistaa syyttömyytensä ottamalla panttivankeja hallituksen toimistotiloissa saadakseen tarpeeksi aikaa totuuden selvittämiseen.

programme.title: Hehkuva kaupunki
programme.desc: On kulunut 200 vuotta siitä; kun viimeiset ihmiset saivat turvapaikan maanalaisesta Emberin kaupungista; mutta nyt suuri genenaattori on menossa rikki.

programme.title: Hamekyttä 2
programme.desc: Hamekytän villissä jatko-osassa Martin Lawrence ja Nia Long palaavatviihdyttämään koko perhettä. Kansakunnan turvallisuus on uhattuna ja FBI-agenttiMalcolm Turner in on jälleen kerran...

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.desc: For the people of Sofia, preserving its heritage is sacrosanct, and this can be seen in the way the city's infrastructure is built around its archeological treasures. Catriona realizes this when she roams around the cobblestone streets of the city. programme.title: Boarding Pass
programme.desc: Levi is Finland's largest and fastest-growing ski destination. Emeline is here, to find out the exciting activities that Levi offers, in summer.

programme.title: Xplore Bhutan
programme.desc: With snow-capped peaks rising over primeval forests and traditional villages, Paro is like an Oriental Switzerland. On a visit to Paro, Radhika explores famous monasteries such as the Rinpung Dzong and Takstang Monastery, and learns the history and legends associated with them. Along the way, she finds out the secrets to the quintessential Bhutanese peace and contentment.

programme.title: Great World Hotels
programme.desc: An invigorating spa treatment, a cooking lesson, a snorkeling session – Kim has experiences in the Maldives that leave her completely rejuvenated.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.desc: From trying Orange zest beer and traditional Dutch dishes to exploring St.Martin's Cathedral, Dom Tower and enjoying go karting and stand up paddle boat ride, watch Alex enjoy his trip in Utrecht.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland

programme.title: Backpack Serbia
programme.desc: Heather explores Nis,one of the oldest cities in Europe.She visits a concentration camp and later paraglides to end by watching a musical performance.

programme.title: Boarding Pass
programme.desc: Emeline goes to Ruka-Kuusamo, where she tries river rafting. She also meets a reindeer herder,who tells her about the unique ways of herding reindeer.

programme.title: Xplore Bhutan
programme.desc: Actress and travel enthusiast, Radhika Bangia explores the enigma that is Bhutan, when she visits Thimpu, the capital city with no traffic lights and no skyscrapers invading the skyline. Here, she checks out significant sights such as the Tibetan-style National Memorial Chorten, the National Library and the Folk Heritage Museum in order to understand more about the beliefs, history, architecture and cuisine of Bhutan.

programme.title: World Heritage
programme.desc: Explore the ancient heritage sites of Abu Simbel, the Philae complex of Nubia and the Hatshepsut Temple to unravel the mystical stories behind the ancient temples of Egypt.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.desc: Alex tries traditional Dutch food in Leiden, learns about Dutch history at Prinsenhof Museum, visits a Gothic church, a local cheese market and Delftware factory at Gouda.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland

programme.title: Backpack Serbia

programme.title: With Love From Mauritius
programme.desc: Krisann and Nathan’s vacation in Mauritius begins in Le Morne, where an unexpected adventure awaits the latter.

programme.title: Xplore Bhutan
programme.desc: Known as Druk Yul or the “Land of the Thunder Dragon”, Bhutan is the country of mountains, monasteries and mystery. Radhika Bangia finds this to be true when she visits Punakha, the former capital of Bhutan, where she marvels at the architecture of Punakha Dzong and gets to know the story behind the two rivers, Mo Chhu and Po Chhu. She also explores the sacred temples and Mebar Tsho lake of Bumthang, the religious heart of Bhutan, and gets to know the local legends.

programme.title: World Spas
programme.desc: Jamie Srubis tries out spa treatments, which are inspired by the Dead Sea and the desert surroundings at Hotel Kempinski Ishtar in Jordan.

programme.title: City break

programme.title: Backpack Serbia
programme.desc: In her final leg of journey, Heather visits the Uvac canyon, tries locally prepared pie, ending with Kopaonik National Park and Jelovarnik waterfalls.

programme.title: With Love From Mauritius
programme.desc: On an island-hopping adventure in Mauritius, Krisann and Nathan find out that time works differently on these islands.

programme.desc: Indeya explores the Cinnamon plantations, tries a local dish and witnesses a traditional dance performance.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.desc: In Amsterdam, Alex tries Bitterballen, cannabis cake and visits Heineken Experience brewery. He explores Zaanse Schans village with windmills and Coster Diamonds, the oldest diamond polishing factory.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland
programme.desc: Robbie’s journey to reconnect with his Scottish roots begins in Edinburgh, the stunning capital city perched on extinct volcanoes. Navigating the twists of the Royal Mile, strutting around the majestic Edinburgh castle and learning to sip scotch like a true Scotsman, he feels a tad closer to his heritage. The real fun kicks in, however, when he stumbles onto a rather flamboyant way to unleash his inner Highlander.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.desc: Like Rome, Plovdiv straddles seven hills; but as Europe’s oldest continuously inhabited city, it’s far more ancient. As Catriona takes a tour of the city to see its iconic attractions such as a Roman Amphitheatre, which was once the setting for gladiator fights, and the striking Baroque Saints Constantine and Helena Church, she begins to see how seamlessly modern life blends with the age-old ruins. Along the way, she realizes why Plovdiv is called the ‘Eternal City’ of Bulgaria.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The World Duel Carnival, where Duelists from around the world will wage heated battles, is swiftly approaching. Yuma, seeking to fulfill his dream of becoming Duel Champion, excitedly rushes to the tournament. But what will Yuma do when he has no Heart Pieces, which serve as the proof of participation for the WDC? Meanwhile, Mr. Heartland and Kite make their preparations to gather the Numbers that are likely to assemble before them in this tournament.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma's first opponent in the World Duel Carnival is the soccer kid, Striker. Striker transforms the surrounding stadium with his Field Spell Card, as the Duel kicks off. With his Offside Trap, Striker brilliantly seals Yuma's strategies, while his teammate monsters use teamwork to frantically keep beating Yuma up with a combo of offense and defense and with such sheer strength, it seems as if Striker's victory is decided...

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: While looking for an opponent to Duel, Yuma meets a boy named Cody, who loves construction equipment, at a construction site. Yuma, interested in the construction equipment Deck Cody uses, challenges him to a Duel. However, Cody Xyz Summons his Digvorzhak, King of Heavy Industry.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Anna Kaboom attempts to kill Yuma with a cannon. He negotiates with her and they Duel instead so that Anna can try to take her revenge. Their past history is not what it initially seems.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Tombo Tillbitty Duels people, defeating them with his Basket Rule and takes their Heart Pieces. Dextra and Nistro appear near one of the defeated Duelists. They see he has vegetables stuffed in his mouth, and Dextra sees blood on his shirt. Dextra inspects closer, and licks it up, telling the disgusted Nistro it's just tomato juice.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Charlie McCay steals Number 7: Lucky Straight from a gallery. Kari, who has past history with Charlie, sends Yuma after him. He and Astral witness the power of the Lucky Straight when Charlie performs a One Turn Kill on a World Duel Carnival competitor. Charlie makes his escape, stealing more cards in the process, including one of Yuma's Numbers.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Charlie McCay escapes on the single-track railroad and Yuma starts the Duel. But Charlie's Number 7: Lucky Straight possesses amazing luck. If he hits the jackpot by rolling the dice, then Charlie's Life Points will become 100,000. On the verge of giving up when all of his attempts to stop that strong luck become fruitless, Yuma discovers an unexpected strategy.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The second day of WDC starts. More energetic than ever, Bronk and Caswell decide to battle the Asian Duel Champion, Quattro. According to these two, the gentleman Quattro has a respectable Duel aesthetic, which is also admired by many Duelists from their hearts. Witnessed by Yuma, Astral, Tori and Trey, the Battle Royal between Quattro, Bronk, and Caswell starts, but Quattro soon reveals his true side which remained hidden until now.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Shark is determined to have his revenge on Quattro, but Quattro's younger brother Trey snares Shark with a Duel Anchor and allows Quattro to leave. Trey's mission from Vetrix and Quinton is to give a Number to Shark, which he accomplishes. Shark is able to resist completely being controlled by the Number and defeats Trey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: After Yuma laments over Shark dueling in revenge against Quattro, he's irritated by everything that's going on and ends up getting into a squabble with Tori. Meanwhile, elsewhere in the tournament, a photographer named Cameron has won Duel after Duel against Duelists with the help of terrifying ability of his that leaves them in terror. Cameron's superpower is apparently a gift to be able to take photographs of the future. With Cameron's Future Photographs, his opponent's entire strategy is laid bare before him, allowing him to relentlessly defeat Duelists.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma is having trouble in his Duel against Cameron, and the dangerous future of Tori encountering an accident is continuously approaching. Then, Number 25: Force Focus, controlled by Cameron, finally shows up. Yuma cannot win without Summoning Utopia, but according to the prophecy, Yuma will lose in this Duel for sure if he Summons it. Under this desperate circumstance, in order to grasp the future within his own hands, Yuma delivers a bold strategy!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: In order to prevent Flip from being disqualified from the WDC, Yuma Duels against Dextra and Nistro. Meanwhile, Astral faces against an old enemy inside Emperor's Key.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: In order to prevent Flip from being disqualified from the WDC, Yuma Duels against Dextra and Nistro. Meanwhile, Astral faces against an old enemy inside Emperor's Key.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The Duel between Yuma against Dextra and Nistro continues. Due to their combination, Yuma is pushed into a corner, even after Summoning Utopia thanks to Astral. However due to the bonds between the two, a reversal occurs!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma's Heart Pieces are stolen by Pip, and Cathy Duels to get them back.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: To heal his little brother Hart's illness, Kite rigorously continues hunting the Number cards. Seeing his older brother exhausted, Hart sneaks away from Heartland and into Heartland City, and by chance meets Yuma, Astral and Tori. Amazingly, Hart can see Astral, who in turn seems to know Hart's name. Moved by Astral's wish, Yuma takes Hart to his home. After Hart escaped from the Heartland Tower, he is chased by Dextra and Nistro in a helicopter which results in them going to a tower in order to meet Kite. Soon after, a helicopter appears, in which Hart, Yuma and Tori think it is Nistro and Dextra, resulting in Hart using his Dark Energy. After Yuma calms Hart down with a piece of...

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Hart is kidnapped by the Vetrix Family and so Kite and Yuma join forces. However when they find their hideout, they're forced into a Tag Duel against Quattro and Trey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The Tag Duel of Yuma and Kite against Quattro and Trey begins! Kite duels essentially on his own, even to the extent of hurting all of his opponents, including Yuma. However, Yuma on his part, defends himself and Kite from Trey and Quattro's damaging combination. Furthermore, even with Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon being Summoned, it falls victim to Quattro and Trey's trap.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Due to the terror of Trey and Quattro's strategy, Kite and Yuma are pushed into a corner. However at the edge of defeat, Hart's feelings awaken a new power inside Kite. With it, he Summons the monster created by the powerful bonds between them, Neo Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma finds himself in conflict about the Number cards, knowing that both Kite and Astral have their reasons for obtaining them. However upon learning that his father is still alive, Yuma tries to leave in search for him. Roku appears to help Yuma with his situation.

programme.title: A King and His Queen
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

Amruta has unwavering faith in relationships, while Virat, on the other hand, has reservations about love, Can they find their way into each other's hearts?

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Amerikan kovimmat keräilijät
programme.desc: Kausi 21. Jakso 30/37. Tuomarin juttusilla. Mike ja Robbie tapaavat Kaliforniassa veljekset, jotka perivät isältään rakennusten purkuun erikoistuneen yrityksen. Toiminta tällä alalla on tuonut sivutuotteena monenlaista rakennuksista pelastettua keräilytavaraa. Mike ja Robbie käyvät myös Floridassa tapaamassa Mikelle jo entuudestaan tuttua 88-vuotiasta keräilijää, jonka ihailtava mielen terävyys ja neuvottelutaidot pistävät kokeneetkin kauppamiehet kovaan testiin. Amerikkalainen realitysarja.

programme.title: Tulossa: Temptation Island Suomi
programme.desc: Viettelysten kuumat tuulet puhaltavat jälleen, kun neljä eri elämäntilanteessa ja parisuhteen vaiheessa olevaa pariskuntaa matkaa Espanjan auringon alle selvittämään, onko nykyinen kumppani se oikea. Pariskunnat laittavat suhteensa todelliseen painetestiin, kun heidät erotetaan toisistaan ja kuvioon astuu liuta kuumia viettelijäsinkkuja. Matkan varrella Sami Kurosen isännöimät iltanuotiot tarjoilevat totutusti väläyksiä kumppanin elämästä toisella villalla. Kauden aikana painitaan pienten sekä isojen kysymysten kanssa. Millainen kumppani on itselle sopiva? Kuinka löytää suhteen kadonnut liekki? Kuinka paljon voi vaatia toista muuttumaan? Voiko pettämisen antaa anteeksi? Viimeisellä iltanuotiolla selviää, onko parisuhteilla edellytyksiä jatkua ohjelman jälkeen. Ja kun viimeinen iltanuotio sammuu, on sinkuille luvassa aivan erityinen yllätys. Kotimainen realityohjelma.

Pampula ja Pelle haaveilevat jo seuraavasta kesästä, kun sokkiuutinen saapuu: Uffe aikoo myydä Nikkarilan! Lapset yrittävät estää Uffea, tuloksetta. Eivätkö he enää voi tulla Saltkråkanille? Vai tekeekö vaatteet päällä uiminen tehdä Melkeristä sankarin? (U)

programme.title: Erlebnisreisen: Peru
programme.desc: Peru ist viermal so groß wie Deutschland. Kaum ein anderes Land ist so vielfältig. Immo Mäueler hat den Andenstaat zwei Wochen lang bereist und faszinierende Aufnahmen mitgebracht.

programme.title: Der Mississippi - Die Seele Amerikas
programme.desc: Mit einer Länge von fast 4000 Kilometern ist der Mississippi zwar nicht der längste Fluss Nordamerikas, aber der bedeutendste. An den Ufern des gewaltigen Stromes leben seit mehreren Tausend Jahren Menschen. Als die Europäer kamen, verdrängten sie die einheimischen Völker. Heute vereint der Fluss viele Kulturen und ist die Seele Amerikas.

programme.title: Kanada - Die Rückkehr der Blackfoot
programme.desc: In der Provinz Alberta in Kanada ist die Landschaft in vielen Regionen noch unberührt und von atemberaubender Schönheit. Hier sind die Blackfoot zu Hause. Sie gehören zu den First Nations in Kanada. Ihr Stammesgebiet erstreckte sich einst über 160.000 Quadratkilometer, eine Fläche fast halb so groß wie Deutschland. Heutzutage sind die Blackfoot mit ihrer Kultur wieder in der Öffentlichkeit präsent. Sie leben ihre Rituale, feiern ihre Traditionen. Dazu gehören Staffelrennen mit Pferden, das sogenannte Indian Relay Racing.

programme.title: Am Pass - Geschichten aus der Spitzenküche

programme.desc: Im Herzen Asiens, isoliert von den Wäldern Sibiriens im Norden und der Chinesischen Mauer im Süden, liegt eine der schönsten und unberührtesten Naturlandschaften der Erde: die Mongolei.

programme.title: Extrem! Heißkalt - Die extremsten Orte der Welt
programme.desc: Das kälteste aller bewohnten Gebiete der Erde ist das Hochland von Oimjakon in Nordostsibirien. Werden die Bewohner dieser Dörfer zu den wenigen Gewinnern der Klimaerwärmung zählen?

programme.title: Extrem! Zwischen Dürre und Sintflut
programme.desc: Regenfälle mit 60 Litern Niederschlag in der Stunde in Österreich, tödliche Trockenheit dagegen am Horn von Afrika - das sind Ereignisse, die mögliche Klimaszenarien vor Augen führen.

programme.title: Extrem! Von höchsten Höhen bis unters Meer
programme.desc: In the near future, some of the settlement areas will become uninhabitable, and new land will need to be tapped into because of climate change. Are there any limitations to realizing the impossible? Filmmaker Udo Maurer's voyage through the world's extremes compares life at sea level with the highest mountains of the world. From the lagoons and palm beaches of the South Sea Islands whose highest peak is often only soem few meters high to the highlands of Ethiopia at four thousand metres. From the shores of Dead Sea, located at 408 meters below sea level, to the 5400 meter high La Rinconada, the gold minder city, in the Peruvian Andes. La Rinconada is not like any other place, it is the highest inhabited place on Earth. If someone dares to go that long stretch, it is only for one reason: to become rich. In fact, there is gold in La Rinconada - and that attracts adventurers from all over the world., In naher Zukunft werden einige der Siedlungsgebiete unbewohnbar werden, und aufgrund des Klimawandels müssen neue Flächen erschlossen werden. Gibt es Grenzen für die Verwirklichung des Unmöglichen? Filmemacher Udo Maurer reist durch die Extreme der Welt und vergleicht das Leben auf Meereshöhe mit den höchsten Bergen der Welt. Von den Lagunen und Palmenstränden der Südseeinseln, deren höchster Gipfel oft nur wenige Meter hoch ist, bis zum viertausend Meter hohen Hochland von Äthiopien. Von den Ufern des Toten Meeres, das 408 Meter unter dem Meeresspiegel liegt, bis zum 5400 Meter hohen La Rinconada, der Goldgräberstadt, in den peruanischen Anden. La Rinconada ist kein Ort wie jeder andere, es ist der höchste bewohnte Ort der Erde. Wenn sich jemand auf diese lange Strecke wagt, dann nur aus einem einzigen Grund: um reich zu werden. Tatsächlich gibt es in La Rinconada Gold - und das lockt Abenteurer aus aller Welt an.

programme.title: Auf Schmugglers Pfaden – Die Wegbereiter Englands (1/3)
programme.desc: An der waldbewachsenen Küste Somersets beginnt der Schmugglerweg. Das artenreiche Hochmoor ist Heimat wilder Exmoor-Ponys und seltener Rothirsche. Der South West Coast Path führt durch die uralten Wälder von Culbone, über die weißen Sandstrände von Putsborough und durch die farbenfrohe Dünenlandschaft bis hin zur schroffen Küste von Hartland.

programme.title: Auf Schmugglers Pfaden – Die Wegbereiter Englands (2/3)
programme.desc: Cornwall im Süden Englands zählt zu den schönsten und vielfältigsten Grafschaften der Insel. Die atemberaubenden Landschaften bieten ein abwechslungsreiches Ökosystem und schaffen besondere klimatische Bedingungen. Berühmt für traditionelle Sport- und Handwerksstätten, ist Cornwall ein Mekka für Kunstschaffende. Der alte Schmugglerweg hat hier ganz besondere Menschen angezogen.

programme.title: Auf Schmugglers Pfaden – Die Wegbereiter Englands (3/3)
programme.desc: Süd-Devon und Dorset bilden die letzten Etappen des über 1000 Kilometer langen South West Coast Path. Die beiden Grafschaften bestechen durch kontrastreiche Lebensräume, prähistorische Spuren und eine reiche kulturelle Tradition. Doch es sind die Menschen entlang des Schmugglerwegs, die Geschichte und Brauchtum lebendig halten und in die Zukunft tragen.

Der Film verfolgt die Spur des schmutzigen Geldes, enthüllt Tricks der Geldwäscher und gewährt exklusive Einblicke in die Arbeit von BKA, Zoll und Steuerfahndung. programme.desc: Alaskan erämaassa elää seitsenlapsinen Brownin perhe. He asuvat yhteiskunnan ulkopuolella ilman mukavuuksia, ja luonnon armoilla he ovat täysin riippuvaisia toisistaan.

programme.title: My Cat From Hell
programme.desc: Taran kissa Cali rakastaa omistajaansa, mutta hyökkää vierailijan päälle. Kurtin kissa Kurtis Jr tuhoaa ja syö kaiken tieltään. Kissojen käytöstuntija Jackson Galaxy saapuu apuun.

programme.title: Pandamonium
programme.desc: Kevään kiima-aika on alkanut, ja vuosittain täytyy syntyä 15 pentua pandapopulaation säilymiseksi. Matkaamme myös Qinling-vuorille tarkkailemaan villipandoja.

programme.title: Das schwarze Quadrat
programme.desc: Die Kunstdiebe Vincent und Nils haben das berühmte russische Gemälde Das schwarze Quadrat gestohlen. Das Bild soll auf einem Kreuzfahrtschiff an den Käufer übergeben werden. Um auf das Schiff zu kommen, überwältigen sie kurzerhand zwei Passagiere.

programme.title: Die Queen und ich
programme.desc: Über ihren Tod hinaus ist Königin Elizabeth II. die berühmteste Frau der Welt. Doch wie sie dachte und empfand, was sie bewegte und inspirierte, blieb ein Geheimnis. Die Queen und ich kommt der legendären Monarchin näher denn je. Die Privatsekretärin, der Freund, der Bischof, der Schneider – erstmals teilen Vertraute aus dem Inner Circle ihre Erinnerungen an die Queen.

programme.title: Die Mythen der Wikinger
programme.desc: Um zu erfahren, was die Zukunft für die Götter Asgards und die anderen Kreaturen des Universums bereithält, muss Göttervater Odin eine schreckliche Prüfung bestehen: Neun Tage und neun Nächte lang wird er am Weltenbaum Yggdrasil hängen, ohne zu essen oder zu trinken. Wenn er Wissen erlangen will, muss er zudem sein linkes Auge opfern. Als er wieder zu sich kommt, hört er ein Wort, das das Schicksal des Universums besiegeln wird: „Ragnarök“.

programme.title: Mit offenen Augen
programme.desc: Bild ist Sprache: die vorherrschende Sprache unserer Welt. Bilder sind mächtig und allgegenwärtig. Wir alle sind tagtäglich einer Flut von Bildern ausgesetzt, die wir mehr oder weniger bewusst wahrnehmen. Was wir sehen, kann schockieren oder bewegen. Aber verstehen wir immer auf den ersten Blick, was wir sehen? Sonia Devillers ordnet Bilder ein und erklärt Hintergründe.

programme.title: 28 Minuten
programme.desc: Bücherherbst: Ananda Devi veröffentlicht ihr neues Werk, Chronique d’un royaume perdu (Chronik eines verlorenen Königreichs, Grasset). / Russische Bedrohung: Emmanuel Macron traf die ersten Freiwilligen des neuen nationalen Dienstes, der als Antwort auf neue sicherheitspolitische Bedrohungen präsentiert wird.

programme.title: 360° Reportage
programme.desc: Mit ihren gewagten Sprüngen und Pirouetten brettern sie gegen hartnäckig fortbestehende Klischees. Ihre Tracht soll provozieren und zeigen, dass den Cholitas heute alles offensteht. Dass sie sich dabei ausgerechnet auf Skateboards schwingen, löst Erstaunen aus. Doch die jungen Bolivianerinnen haben diesen Sport mit Bedacht gewählt ...

programme.title: Küchen der Welt
programme.desc: Maniok nach ivorischer Art: Placali mit Okra-Soße / Ein Biss'chen Heimat: Batty, eine Ivorerin in Toulouse / Ran an die Töpfe!

programme.title: Der Orient-Express - Vintage auf Schienen
programme.desc: ARTE entdeckt den Orient: An Bord des Orientexpress geht es an die Grenzen Europas, Afrikas und Asiens. Die Traumreise folgt dem Nil auf den Spuren der Märchen von Tausendundeiner Nacht und lässt Aladin und die Wunderlampe oder auch die Abenteuer von Sindbad dem Seefahrer lebendig werden. Entlang der berühmten Seidenstraße führt der Weg durch Zentralasien zwischen Iran und Indien. Im Orient begegnen sich verschiedene Religionen – er ist die Wiege des Christentums und des Islam. Entdecken Sie die Wege des Orients am 20. Mai auf ARTE.

programme.title: Die Eisenbahn - Motor des Fortschritts
programme.desc: Seit etwa 200 Jahren gibt es die Eisenbahn – sie ist ein bahnbrechendes Transportmittel der Menschheit geworden. Ihr Siegeszug hat Gesellschaften, Landschaften und Städte verändert und ganze Länder ins Industriezeitalter katapultiert. Sie revolutionierte den Transport und demokratisierte das Reisen. Doch sie war auch ein Werkzeug der Kolonialmächte zur Ausbeutung und transportierte Menschen in den geplanten Tod in Auschwitz.

programme.title: Re ARTE
programme.desc: Italiens traditionelle Zeitungskioske, sind seit jeher Orte, an denen sich Anwohner treffen, um Zeitungen zu kaufen und sich über ihren Alltag auszutauschen. Doch in den letzten 15 Jahren sind zwei Drittel der kleinen Geschäfte verschwunden. Die Gründe dafür liegen an der Digitalisierung des Zeitungsmarktes. Bürger kämpfen darum, verbliebene Kioske zu erhalten - mit Erfolg.

programme.desc: Der Festtagseintopf aus Polynesien: Pua'a choux / Kulinarische Mitbringsel / Ran an die Töpfe!
